items.comment: First sentence stands alone, accurately describes that unapply always returns Some(x). @tparam lines correctly ordinal (1st..20th) and match the style used in the sibling Product20 trait doc. @return is technically redundant with the first sentence per the general rule, but this mirrors the existing convention in this same file (e.g. _1..._20 projections each restate their summary in @return), so it's consistent rather than a deviation.
